---
title: "Exploration"
subtitle: "Interactive exploration of Golden Retriever health and longevity"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Use the controls below to choose what data you want to see from the Golden Retriever Lifetime Study cohort. You can filter by region, sex, body condition, and age range, and switch between the interactive chart and the data table.

```{r}
#| label: setup-crosstalk

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)
library(DT)

dogs <- read_csv("golden_retrievers.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  filter(
    Body_condition_categorical %in% c("Underweight", "Normal", "Overweight", "Obese"),
    Region_of_residence != ""
  ) |> 
  transmute(
    ID = ID,
    Region = Region_of_residence,
    Sex = Sex,
    Body_Condition = factor(Body_condition_categorical, levels = c("Underweight", "Normal", "Overweight", "Obese")),
    Enrollment_Age = round(Age_at_enrollment_years, 1),
    Current_Age = round(Age_current_years, 1),
    Follow_Up_Years = round(Total_follow_up_time_years, 1),
    Diagnosis = if_else(Primary_endpoint == "" | is.na(Primary_endpoint), "None", Primary_endpoint)
  )

shared_dogs <- dogs |> 
  SharedData$new()
```

```{r}
#| label: filters

bscols(
  widths = c(3, 3, 3, 3),
  filter_select("region", "Region:", shared_dogs, ~Region),
  filter_select("sex", "Sex:", shared_dogs, ~Sex),
  filter_select("body_condition", "Body Condition:", shared_dogs, ~Body_Condition),
  filter_slider("age", "Current Age (years):", shared_dogs, ~Current_Age, step = 0.5)
)
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Interactive Scatter Plot

```{r}
#| label: interactive-plot

plot_ly(
  shared_dogs,
  x = ~Enrollment_Age,
  y = ~Current_Age,
  color = ~Body_Condition,
  colors = "Set2",
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(opacity = 0.65, size = 7),
  text = ~paste0(
    "<b>ID:</b> ", ID, "<br>",
    "<b>Region:</b> ", Region, "<br>",
    "<b>Sex:</b> ", Sex, "<br>",
    "<b>Body Condition:</b> ", Body_Condition, "<br>",
    "<b>Enrollment Age:</b> ", Enrollment_Age, " yrs<br>",
    "<b>Current Age:</b> ", Current_Age, " yrs<br>",
    "<b>Diagnosis:</b> ", Diagnosis
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text"
) |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Age at Enrollment (years)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Current Age (years)"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Body Condition"))
  )
```

## Searchable Data Table

```{r}
#| label: interactive-table

datatable(
  shared_dogs,
  options = list(pageLength = 10, dom = "tip", scrollX = TRUE),
  rownames = FALSE
)
```

:::
